---
title: "RNA Seq Enrichments"
output: html_document
date: "2024-01-28"
params: 
    exp_list: !r rna_seq_exp
    output_dir: !r output_dir
    ora_filter: !r expression(Factor_1_weights_sig)
    gsea_cols_list: !r gsea_cols_list
    gsea: TRUE
    universe: NULL
    order_column: "Factor_1_weights"
    results_name: "Factor_1"
    legend_name: "Fold Change (log2)"
    random_seed: 1234
---

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

```{r}
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(DESeq2)
library(sva)
library(mixOmics)
library(knitr)
library(DT)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(dplyr)
library(msigdbr)
library(MultiAssayExperiment)
source("../../scripts/Utility_Functions/utilities.R")
```

## Enrichment analysis {.tabset}

```{r}
enrich_results_list <- list()
```


### Table results {.tabset}

```{r}
contrs_names <- names(params$exp_list)

contrs_result_sig_list <- lapply(contrs_names, function(ctrs_name){
    ctrs <- params$exp_list[[ctrs_name]]
    as.data.frame(ctrs[order(ctrs[[params$order_column]]),])
})
names(contrs_result_sig_list) <- contrs_names

tables_chunk <- significant_tables_chunks(contrs_result_sig_list = contrs_result_sig_list, 
                                          contrs_names = contrs_names, template = c(
    "#### `r contrs_names[{{i}}]` \n",
    "```{r, echo = FALSE}\n",
    "datatable(contrs_result_sig_list[[{{i}}]], options = list(scrollX = TRUE)) %>% formatRound(columns = colnames(contrs_result_sig_list[[{{i}}]])[sapply(contrs_result_sig_list[[{{i}}]], is.numeric)], digits = 3)",
    "```\n",
    "\n"
))
```

`r knit(text=unlist(tables_chunk))`

```{r}
sig_genes <- lapply(params$exp_list, function(ctrs){
    rownames(ctrs[eval(params$ora_filter, envir = ctrs),])
})

genes_gsea <- lapply(names(params$gsea_cols_list), function(ctrs_name){
    ctrs <- params$exp_list[[ctrs_name]]
    fc_list <- ctrs[[params$gsea_cols_list[[ctrs_name]]]]
    names(fc_list) <- rownames(ctrs)
    fc_list
})
names(genes_gsea) <- names(params$gsea_cols_list)
```

<!-- ### GO {.tabset} -->

```{r, cache=TRUE}
set.seed(params$random_seed)
enrich_results <- multi_enrich(dt_to_pathway = sig_genes, universe = NULL, 
                                OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db, keyType = "ENSEMBL", 
                                qvalueCutoff = 0.05, pAdjustMthd = "fdr", 
                                pvalueCutoff = 0.05, simplify_res = FALSE)
for(i in seq_along(enrich_results)){
    for(id in seq_along(enrich_results[[i]])){
        enrich_results[[i]][[id]]@result$enrichFC <- calculate_enrich_fc(enrich_results[[i]][[id]]) 
    }
    enrich_results[[i]] <- lapply(enrich_results[[i]], simplify, cutoff = 0.7, 
                                  by = "enrichFC", select_fun = max)
}

enrich_results_list$ORA <- c(enrich_results_list$ORA, enrich_results)

# enrich_plot_data <- enrich_plots(enrich_results, fold_change_list = genes_gsea, 
#                                  legend_name = params$legend_name)
```

<!-- ## GSEA {.tabset} -->

```{r}
enrich_results_list$GSEA <- list()
```

<!-- ### GO {.tabset} -->

```{r, eval = params$gsea}
set.seed(params$random_seed)
enrich_results <- multi_enrich(dt_to_pathway = genes_gsea, universe = NULL, 
                                OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db, keyType = "ENSEMBL", 
                                qvalueCutoff = 0.05, pAdjustMthd = "fdr", 
                                pvalueCutoff = 0.05, simplify_res = FALSE, 
                                enrichFun = "gsea")

for(i in seq_along(enrich_results)){
    for(id in seq_along(enrich_results[[i]])){
        enrich_results[[i]][[id]]@result$enrichmentScoreAbs <- abs(enrich_results[[i]][[id]]@result$enrichmentScore)
    }
    enrich_results[[i]] <- lapply(enrich_results[[i]], simplify, cutoff = 0.7, 
                                  by = "enrichmentScoreAbs", select_fun = max)
}

enrich_results_list$GSEA <- c(enrich_results_list$GSEA, enrich_results)


# enrich_plot_data <- enrich_plots(enrich_results, fold_change_list = genes_gsea, 
#                                  legend_name = params$legend_name)
```

```


```{r, results='asis', fig.height=8, fig.width=8}
for(enrich_type in names(enrich_results_list)){
    enrich_type_list <- enrich_results_list[[enrich_type]]
    cat("### ", enrich_type, "{.tabset} \n")
    cat("\n")
    
    enrich_plot_data <- enrich_plots(enrich_type_list, 
                                    fold_change_list = Map(c, genes_gsea, genes_entrez_ids), 
                                    legend_name = params$legend_name)
    enrich_chunks(enrichData_all = enrich_type_list, 
                    enrich_plot_data = enrich_plot_data)
    cat("\n")
}
```
